name: Imouto Taisou ~Oshiete Onii-chan~
original_name: 妹体操 ～教えてっお兄ちゃん～
source:
Rina is a clumsy girl who needs practice to enter a sports school. She requests onii-chan to help her with gymnastics.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/10/vn-of-month-august-2005-saihate-no-ima.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
Rina是個笨手笨腳的女孩。為了考進體育學校，她需要加強練習，於是拜託哥哥幫她練習體操。

[摘自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/10/vn-of-month-august-2005-saihate-no-ima.html]vndbreview[/url]]
